goal: Reduce the public API size of Navigator by migrating callers from deprecated declaration lookup methods to the existing NavigatorDeclarationLookup API.

ops.details: Replace calls to the deprecated Navigator declaration lookup methods with calls to the corresponding existing NavigatorDeclarationLookup methods before removing the forwarding methods.

Consolidate the deprecated declaration lookup forwarding methods into NavigatorDeclarationLookup and remove the redundant methods from Navigator. The destination methods already exist and must remain the single implementation.
